controller_evaluator_separation.evaluator_input: Each case evaluator_only only to independent scorer

external_reference_register.name: Benchmarking integrated indoor localization and tracking using dead reckoning
external_reference_register.claim_limit: Methodology alignment reference only; this v0.1 corpus is not yet declared conformant.

external_reference_register.name: UrbanNav multisensor urban-canyon localization dataset
external_reference_register.claim_limit: Candidate dataset for exact sequence/release review; no data imported or result reproduced.

external_reference_register.name: SubT-MRS all-weather subterranean SLAM dataset
external_reference_register.claim_limit: Candidate localization/perception sequences only; no mine safety or full-site positioning inference.

external_reference_register.name: Tank underwater stereo/IMU/DVL/depth SLAM dataset
external_reference_register.claim_limit: Controlled tank SLAM only; no open-ocean or commercial-use claim. Requires license-compatible use.

external_reference_register.name: GNSS spoofing detection in-domain and cross-domain evaluation
external_reference_register.claim_limit: Reported metrics apply only to the study's datasets, receivers, splits and scoring protocol.

external_reference_register.name: Starling Formation-flying Optical eXperiment relative navigation
external_reference_register.claim_limit: On-orbit angles-only relative navigation demonstration; not a general benchmark dataset or docking qualification.

external_reference_register.name: Conflict-aware evidence fusion for robust decentralized cooperative localization
external_reference_register.claim_limit: Abstract describes conflict-aware evidence, Bayesian credibility, entropy and CI-compatible discounting with simulation and real multi-robot evaluation; exact reproduction requires the full protocol, code/data availability, rights and matched metrics.

external_reference_register.name: Resilient distributed localization for mobile sensor networks under malicious attacks
external_reference_register.claim_limit: Abstract describes innovation-based saturation with covariance intersection and bounded covariance analysis; results apply only to the paper's threat model and evaluated setup.

external_reference_register.name: Integrity as a Control Problem: Smooth and Adaptive Protection Levels for Multi-Modal Localization
external_reference_register.claim_limit: Paper reports empirical PL results on selected UrbanNav sequences and does not evaluate availability/continuity; protection-level saturation ceiling is a required negative-control hypothesis, not an accepted integrity theorem.

external_reference_register.name: Stress testing visual-inertial odometry under sensor perturbations on CERBERUS subterranean datasets
external_reference_register.claim_limit: Published preprint tests four VIO systems under nine perturbations on CERBERUS data; one-factor perturbation design and exact artifact availability must be reviewed before reproduction.

external_reference_register.name: OdoTest: An Automated Testing Approach for Odometry Systems
external_reference_register.claim_limit: Automated testing protocol reference only; exact perturbation generators, version, ground truth and replication artifacts must be audited.

external_reference_register.name: Lightweight standalone temporal calibration for visual-inertial odometry on resource-constrained embedded systems
external_reference_register.claim_limit: Abstract reports camera-IMU temporal calibration results on EuRoC sequences; reported timing/accuracy are paper-specific and require matched hardware, reference and protocol reproduction.

external_reference_register.name: A decoupled backend optimizer for UWB localization in NLOS environments
external_reference_register.claim_limit: Abstract describes joint refinement of initial positions and residual ranging errors; code/data, exact NLOS model, licensing and matched measurement protocol remain to be reviewed.

targets: Zero accepted frame/body/time-basis mix-ups in the frozen negative-control corpus.
Zero false independence decisions for known common-mode cases.
Zero premature healthy-state re-entry in the frozen synthetic recovery corpus.
Empirical uncertainty-region coverage consistent with declared confidence and assumptions.

At matched operating point, pursue at least 20% reduction in p95 trajectory error or unqualified-position exposure on one preregistered transition profile without worsening false alarms or false-safe exposure.
100% of decision-relevant outputs bind exact input/configuration/profile/transform/time/evidence/oracle references or return INDETERMINATE.
100% byte-reproducible replay of the frozen synthetic corpus.

split_policy: Group by complete recording, route, site, session, receiver/device, campaign and environmental condition.
Do not place overlapping windows from one trajectory across train/validation/test.
Freeze split manifest and benchmark subject before final evaluation.
Declare public-test exposure and previous tuning use; do not label exposed tests as pristine blind evidence.
prerequisites_before_preregistration: Freeze the 12-case corpus, exact seeds, profile assumptions and one primary outcome per profile before held-out evaluation.
Implement and execute semantic validation plus a full JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 validator.
Complete external dataset rights, version, calibration and ground-truth audits.
Pin matched classical and benchmark-native baselines.
Review the exact Symtropy model-capability path; unsupported physics stays abstract or unknown.
Reproduce or document non-reproducibility of the 2026 DECLARE and innovation-saturation-plus-CI method comparators under exact protocol and rights constraints.
Add positive-control/negative-control ablations for conflict detection, source credibility, covariance discounting and common-mode provenance.
Compare passive fixed-rate measurement with observability-aware active sensing using matched travel/energy/time costs.
Add and preregister integrity/protection-level saturation and heavy-tail episodes, including cap-exhaustion negative controls and qualified recovery.
Reproduce or document non-reproducibility of the 2026 adaptive protection-level and Student-t comparators with availability/continuity reported separately.
Audit OdoTest, UnderSubT VIO stress-test and camera–IMU temporal-calibration artifacts/rights before admitting external results.
